# Schema of CSDL JSON

`csdl.schema.json` is the JSON Schema of the JSON representation of the
Common Schema Definition Language of OData Version 4.01, published by
OASIS at
<https://docs.oasis-open.org/odata/odata-csdl-json/v4.01/os/schemas/csdl.schema.json>.
Copyright © OASIS Open 2020. All Rights Reserved. It is part of the
OASIS Standard OData Common Schema Definition Language (CSDL) JSON
Representation Version 4.01 and is used unchanged, only by tests that
check the metadata documents of services.
